args.summary: Following deployment of v2.3.1, checkout-api failed health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification confirms service is healthy with error rate at 0.2%. v2.3.1 requires investigation before any re-deploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed** the issue: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all three production regions — error rate 18%.
2. **Rolled back** all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
3. **Verified** the rollback: service is now healthy across all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` documenting the failure and rollback (on-call has been paged).

Note: v2.3.1 needs investigation before it can be re-deployed — per policy, deploying it again would require change-manager approval since it's never been healthy in production.
